title: Population Health-Based Machine Learning Reveals Associations Between Psychosocial Factors and Chronic Kidney Disease
abstract: arXiv:2608.17174v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) progresses silently and severely undermines quality of life, making early detection critical for improving patient outcomes. We present a two-part study that combines large-scale telehealth data with advanced machine learning to both classify self-reported CKD status and identify key drivers of disease. Using selected features from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS 2021: 438,693 samples; BRFSS 2019: 418,268 samples) and the National Health Interview Survey (NHIS 2021: 29,482 samples; NHIS 2020: 31,568 samples), we addressed missing data with nine state-of-the-art imputation methods and mitigated class imbalance via sampling strategies. Our customized stacked ensemble model achieved balanced accuracy of 72.56-76.12%, with corresponding AUROC scores of 79.59-82.29%. translated_abstract: 慢性肾脏病（CKD）悄无声息地进展，严重损害生活质量，因此早期检测对于改善患者预后至关重要。我们提出了一项由两部分组成的研究，结合大规模远程医疗数据与先进机器学习，既对自我报告的CKD状态进行分类，又识别疾病的关键驱动因素。使用来自行为风险因素监测系统（BRFSS 2021：438,693个样本；BRFSS 2019：418,268个样本）和全国健康访谈调查（NHIS 2021：29,482个样本；NHIS 2020：31,568个样本）的选定特征，我们通过九种最先进的插补方法处理缺失数据，并通过采样策略缓解类别不平衡。我们定制的堆叠集成模型实现了72.56-76.12%的平衡准确率，相应的AUROC分数为79.59-82.29%。SHapley加法解释（SHAP）分析，随后进行临床审查，突出了关键预测因素，包括定期...
tldr: 本研究利用大规模健康调查数据和定制堆叠集成机器学习模型，在有效分类慢性肾脏病的同时，通过SHAP分析揭示了心理社会因素（如定期行为）作为疾病关键驱动因素的新关联。
en_tdlr: This study leverages large-scale health survey data and a customized stacked ensemble machine learning model to effectively classify chronic kidney disease while revealing, via SHAP analysis, novel associations of psychosocial factors (e.g., regular behaviors) as key disease drivers.
